instructions: Evaluate only the target message in context. Allow good-faith discussion, educational material, reporting, and non-endorsing quotation. Quoted abuse used to attack someone is still a violation. Do not penalize ordinary disagreement or profanity alone.

filters.definition: Targeted abuse, degrading insults, or sustained intimidation of a person. Ordinary disagreement, criticism of ideas, and profanity alone are not violations.

Attacks, dehumanization, or advocacy of exclusion or violence against people because of protected characteristics such as race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, or disability. Neutral reporting and counterspeech are not violations.

Credible statements of intent, encouragement, or instructions to physically harm a person or group. Figurative frustration, fictional discussion, and reporting threats without endorsement are not violations.
Graphic sexual descriptions, explicit sexual solicitation, or sexual exploitation. Non-graphic health education, consent discussion, and abuse reporting are not violations.
Encouraging, glorifying, or instructing suicide or self-injury. Seeking help, expressing distress, recovery stories, and supportive responses are not violations.
Deceptive attempts to obtain money, credentials, or sensitive information, including impersonation and fraudulent offers. Discussing or warning about scams is not a violation.
Unsolicited promotional flooding, repetitive irrelevant advertising, or deceptive bulk solicitation. Relevant recommendations and a single legitimate on-topic link are not violations.
